messages:
Alex R.: Quick sync on the NovaHealth POC timeline — need to lock owners for integration deliverables this week. Go/no-go decision targeted for Mon. @Maya S. can you confirm the egress window and cert handoff?
Maya S.: I can take network/egress. We have a maintenance window Thurs 02:00–04:00 UTC for outbound rules. Need the IP list from SEs by EOD Wed.
Jordan (SE): Copy. I'll drop the IP ranges into the tracker. Also: who owns SSO config + test user matrix?
Priya K.: I can own SSO setup (SAML). Will need the IdP metadata and a list of 6 test accounts with roles. ETA initial config by Fri.
Ethan L.: Staging endpoint is standing up. Basic health is green. I pushed a small schema change for event webhook payloads — tagging @Alex R. for approval.
Alex R.: Where did you put the schema diff? Paste the snippet here please.
Ethan L.: Here — lightweight diff:
```json
- event: { user_id, action }
+ event: { user_id, action, model_version }
```
Need signoff because SEs will wire the model_version to their logs.
Jordan (SE): Signoff from me, we need model_version to correlate regressions. :thumbsup:
Maya S.: Ops note: private cert deploy requires cert chain on load balancer. @Ethan L. make sure the cert name matches the DNS entry nova-staging.redwood.
Ethan L.: Will do. Also QA wants a reproducible sample for acceptance tests. Minimal success criteria agreed with customer:
- 95% intent match on 50 eval prompts
- end-to-end webhook latency < 500ms (95th)
I'll add a small harness and share results.
Priya K.: For SSO tests, I'll need a staging test user for each role mapped to NovaHealth roles. Can SEs create those in the tracker?
Jordan (SE): Yes, creating now. Also adding integration checklist items: IPs, cert, SSO metadata, webhook URL, sample payloads, and one-off prompt set for eval.
Alex R.: Can we call out owners in one place? I'll update the POC doc with owners: Network: Maya S., SSO: Priya K., Staging infra + schema: Ethan L., SE lead: Jordan (SE), PM: Alex R.
ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: cert-rollover-job -> Thu 02:15 UTC (requires 15m downtime for LB cert swap).
Maya S.: Re: downtime — can we make it zero-downtime? If we have the new cert preloaded we can swap without connection drops. I'll coordinate with infra.
Ethan L.: I'll pre-load the cert into the staging LB today.
Alex R.: Final ask: SEs, please upload the customer eval prompts and success criteria to the tracker by EOD. Once we have IPs + test accounts + certs, we can run the acceptance on Fri morning.
Jordan (SE): Will do. Uploading prompts now.
Maya S.: IP list received and added.
Priya K.: IdP metadata received from NovaHealth — imported to staging. Running initial login tests, will report failures here.
Ethan L.: Kickoff acceptance run scheduled Fri 09:00 UTC. I'll post results and a short log snippet here.
Alex R.: Thanks team — this is good progress. If any blocker pops up ping me directly. :rocket:
